_comment: All clinical cut-offs live here so they can be reviewed without touching code. Adult patients only.

critical._comment: Suspected ESI 1: call for immediate help.

dangerZone._comment: ESI decision point D (adult): consider ESI 2.

painScale._comment: Piecewise-linear map from the raw expression score (sum of AU4, AU6/7 and AU9/10 blendshapes, 0..3) to 0-10, aligned with NRS bands: 1-3 mild, 4-6 moderate, 7-10 severe.

quality._comment: minFps gates the start of a measurement; below the unclear* values the result is 'Unclear' instead of 'Routine'.
